# Order of the per-family Gencode/rRNA blocks in a MASTER_FILELIST, one family per line.
#
# Taken from the hg38 reference file, where the Gencode region is 32 contiguous runs --
# one per genelists.<FAMILY> source list. read_in_filelists assigns priority_n in file
# order, but the priority comparison in parse_bowtie2_output_... is keyed BY FAMILY
# (flags{$ensttype}), so this between-family order does not affect any count; it keeps the
# generated file diffable against the reference. Families absent here are appended in
# first-seen order.
